title: Versatilidad
body: Para mí es uno de los sistemas para tomar notas más versátiles que existen en el ecosistema de Apple. Es sencillo es directo y tiene pequeñas herramientas que nos permiten la organización y la edición del texto que colocamos dentro. Aparte de poder colocar hiper vínculos imágenes y otras características que son muy útiles para guardar nuestra información de manera segura.

title: Notes on Notes.
body:
Notes is … (-interrupted by iPhone corrector - You should say notes are!) 
Let us start by saying that “Notes” is perhaps  for me one of the most useful of App.
We are being left behind by the evolution of technology. 
Technology is not part of nature, it’s a man-made thing, sometimes it is really unnatural.
Humans evolve slowly through generations, but technology has no respect for the speed of nature’s evolution.
Our great grandparents didn’t have much to remember. Their memories were great, for the amount of things they were supposed to do in one day; in one week, in one year, in their whole lifetime. 
Now, because of the evolution of technology, everyone is expected to do so much more everyday, every hour, every minute, every second. 
Our memories have not evolved yet to do so many tasks per second, to keep up with so many things, to have to remember such huge amounts of information.
Notes, like heavenly music from cores of angels, come to my rescue, specially with it’s “Search” 
I have so many notes in my Notes of everything, things you could not even imagine in your wildest dreams!
Technology is very cruel with elderly people. People like me, people that still remember when they installed the first telephone in my house. 
There it was this devilish apparatus pinned to the wall, waiting for you to come up with your mouth to meet its mouth piece as if you were going to kiss it! 
Then you would unhook its ear piece put it on to one of your ears with one hand, and with the other you would have to spin it’s manibel or handle so that it would immediately make a strange unnatural sound, similar to a bell ringing. You would have to do that sometimes several times until something similar to a females voice ask you: who do you want to talk to? Do you know his telephone number?
So, now in our old age we ha to learn how to use these technologies, and as soon as you manage to learn the know how, they change the way to do it. Software update, they call it.

Thank you for Notes. Please, please I beg you, don’t change Notes! Never update it!
author: Fufa Storyteller.
